Name: Samsara Eco
Description:
We’re a circular materials biotech breaking the linear take-make-waste economy. 

Using AI-designed enzymes, our enzymatic recycling technology breaks down plastics and textiles into their original building blocks, creating virgin-identical circular materials ready for brands' next collections. 

Today, we’re focused on creating circular nylon and polyester. But our end game is to find circular solutions for the trickiest of plastics, so no garment, no vehicle, no bottle is left behind. Instead, it's reborn, again and again. 

Samsara Eco launched in 2021 in partnership with the Australian National University (ANU), and with backing from Main Sequence and the Woolworths Group. We have raised over USD $107M from our growing supporters including Temasek, Breakthrough VIC, DCVC, CEFC, lululemon, Hitachi Ventures, Titanium Ventures and Wollemi. Our growing team of 80+ are spread across APAC, Europe and North America.

Description:

Rumin8 is targeting commercialisation of a multi-product solution to suit a variety of livestock management systems, including grass-fed cattle, with potential value adds for producers.

Name: MCi Carbon
Description:
MCi Carbon (MCi) is a world-leading and award-winning Australian clean technology transforming carbon dioxide (CO2) into building products and materials for the circular carbon economy. 

Based in Canberra, MCi Carbon has a technical headquarters in Newcastle, a global reference pilot plant at the Newcastle Institute of Energy and Resources (NIER) and will soon be building one of the world's first mineral carbonation demonstration plants at Orica's Kooragang Island manufacturing site, operational in 2024.

Founded in 2013, MCi’s proprietary mineral carbonation technology is a low-cost, low-pressure, low-energy chemical engineering process to transform CO2 emissions from industrial sources into solid materials for use in a range of products.

MCi has received local and international recognition for its R&D, recently awarded the Circular Transition Award at the 34th National Banksia Sustainability Awards and the NSW Clean Technology Award. In 2021, MCi won first prize at the Clean Energy Start-up Pitch Battle at COP26 in Glasgow. Other global accolades include the 2018 Resource Innovator of the Year Award at the New Materials Summit in Berlin and being featured at the World Economic Forum Pioneers of Change Summit, building momentum as a global brand and a leader in carbon capture and utilisation (CCU). 

Recently featured in Bloomberg, Forbes, and the Australian Financial Review, MCi CEO Marcus Dawe and COO Sophia Hamblin Wang were named in the Top 100 Australian Green Power Players, published in The Australian.

Through innovation and analytical engineering, driven by world class expertise, Fusion Modulair is proud to be at the vanguard of deploying industry leading climate control solutions for large-volume spaces. With applications ranging from retail, wholesale, sensitive temperature-controlled storage, to large sporting and public venues, Fusion’s integrated systems work intelligently together to provide adaptable, reliable and exceptionally efficient operation based on continuous metrics and data analysis.

Because the product is the same as natural gas, it can be brought to Australian customers through existing gas pipeline systems and it can be shipped overseas.

Our first project in Western Australia aims to remove more than 10 million tonnes of CO2 from the atmosphere.

While the hydrogen gas can be sold as a clean fuel, Turquoise Group's key value driver is the continuous reformation of solid carbon into superior carbon products, including high quality graphene. Graphene is a revolutionary material with the capacity to transform and disrupt established markets and technologies. To date, high manufacturing costs have hindered its widespread use.

Turquoise Group aims to mass produce low-cost, high-quality graphene to unlock its true potential as a substitute feedstock for a wide range of next-generation products.

Name: Corellian Technologies Pty Ltd
Description:
Corellian has developed a disruptive, low-cost cooling technology that cuts electricity usage by up to 95%—tackling the global cooling crisis by finally resolving the "green premium" trap in the HVAC industry.

AirSolaris is our next-generation liquid desiccant-evaporative air conditioning system, specifically engineered for compactness and mass manufacturability. By utilizing low-grade heat (40-100°C) to drive cooling and dehumidification, AirSolaris eliminates the need for electricity-hungry compressors and chemical refrigerants. Furthermore, its integrated thermal energy storage effectively flattens evening peak grid demand, paving the way for a future less reliant on costly fossil fuels.

THE CORELLIAN ADVANTAGE 
While the market for thermal-storage ACs is accelerating, AirSolaris leaps past early-generation limitations. We use an advanced non-corrosive liquid, eliminating the maintenance and hardware degradation risks associated with traditional salt-based desiccants. Furthermore, our proprietary design achieves unparalleled power density and manufacturing cost.

OUR BUSINESS MODEL 
Through our "Corellian Inside" licensing and co-development model, we empower incumbent Tier-1 HVAC manufacturers. We provide them with the core technology required to bypass strict refrigerant phase-out regulations (Kigali Amendment), preserve their hardware margins, and unlock highly profitable "Cooling-As-A-Service" (CaaS) revenue streams.

TRACTION & MARKETS 
AirSolaris is the ideal cooling engine for high-growth, heat-stressed sectors, including AI Data Centres, industrial facilities, and residential markets. Supported by the CSIRO-backed India-Australia RISE Accelerator, and European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), our technology has reached TRL 6 and is currently in active joint-pilot development and digital-twin modelling with global industrial cooling leaders.

Name: COOloop
Description:
COOloop is a London-based deep-tech company developing a proprietary catalyst platform to convert CO2 and green hydrogen directly into ultra-low carbon ethanol.
Our technology is based on a novel metal-organic framework (MOF) derived catalyst, originally developed through PhD and postdoctoral research at Monash University. Unlike biological fermentation routes, our thermochemical process converts CO2 and H2 directly into ethanol.
Using biogenic CO2 and green hydrogen, our process can achieve negative greenhouse gas intensity — providing significant compliance advantages under RFNBO regulations and positioning our ethanol as a structurally differentiated product in mandate-driven fuel markets.
Our target markets:
• Road fuel compliance — EU RED III and the German Quoten system
• Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) via the Alcohol-to-Jet (ATJ) pathway
• Industrial solvents and pharma-grade ethanol
Where we are:
Currently at TRL 4–5, with demonstrated catalyst stability across multiple batch cycles and ethanol production from CO2 and H2 confirmed in the lab. We are progressing to continuous flow process testing, the critical step toward pilot scale and filing IP to protect our ethanol production route.
We are in active discussion with several large industry players on technical collaboration, scale-up and commercial partnership.
COOloop was incorporated in August 2025 and is currently raising its pre-seed round.

Name: Below Baseline
Description:
Climate reporting is now mandatory for growing importance to Australian business. Group 1 companies are already lodging under AASB S2, Group 2 periods have started, and if you supply either, the questionnaires are coming whether the legislation names you or not.

Most companies will treat this as paperwork. Fair enough, it looks like paperwork. But you're about to spend real money measuring where your energy, freight and supplier spend actually goes. It would be a shame to file the result and learn nothing from it.

That's the gap Below Baseline works in. We offer two workstreams for Australian SMEs and mid-market organisations:
- Business decision-making regarding climate-related risk and strategy: Using your sustainability data and internal knowledge to make calls on suppliers, strategy, capital and risk.
- Measurement and calculation: Emissions baselines and Scope 1, 2 and 3 accounting, aligned to AASB S2, the GHG Protocol and NGER.

We prepare clients for assurance along the way, because a number that can't survive an auditor isn't worth much.

We build software too. Sustainability Baseline is our carbon accounting and ESG reporting platform, built on Microsoft Dataverse and Azure, so it runs in the environment most mid-market Australian businesses already operate. We're a Microsoft partner and also deliver Microsoft Sustainability Manager engagements in customer tenancies.

Not sure where your business lands under ASRS? Book an assessment at belowbaseline.com. It's the quickest way to find out.

Our strength lies in our diverse team's unity, together navigating product challenges and evolving consumer needs. We're transparently moving towards a carbon-neutral future, with each decision echoing our commitment.

Guided by inclusivity, respect for the planet, and cultural celebration, i1 Future is paving the way for a harmonious, sustainable future where people and nature coexist prosperously.

Name: Renergi
Description:
Renergi is an exciting sustainability startup that has developed a suite of revolutionary patented technologies that permanently remove atmospheric carbon through the creation of valuable bioenergy and biocarbon products manufactured from agricultural, forestry, and municipal wastes that would have otherwise been discarded to release emissions.

Renergi's technology and products are part of a bio-based circular economy that contributes to the environmental and social frameworks in which we live in a profoundly positive way.

Name: FreakLabs
Description:
Innovating technology for conservation impact

At FreakLabs, we design, build and deploy rugged, scalable technology solutions that empower conservationists, ecologists, researchers and land managers to collect and act on environmental data in the world’s most challenging landscapes. Our mission is to harness innovation and collaboration to develop tools that help understand, preserve and restore the natural world.

We bring decades of expertise in hardware engineering, wireless communications, embedded systems, and product manufacturing to address real-world environmental challenges—from biodiversity monitoring to soil health, human-wildlife conflict, and non-lethal pest deterrence. Working closely with domain experts, NGOs, research institutes and global organizations, we ensure our technology is both affordable and built for purpose in remote, harsh field conditions.

Our core innovations include the Baseliner product line: a modular, real-time wireless environmental monitoring platform that transmits field data directly to the internet for seamless integration and analysis, and the Boombox product line: a multi-modal automated behavioral response system for playback experiments in wildlife behavioral research and non-lethal audio and multi-modal deterrence. 

Beyond product development, we support long-term conservation impact through capacity building, consulting and data solutions, helping partners understand, maintain and scale technology deployments while transforming raw data into actionable insights.

Name: Clean Carbon
Description:
Clean Carbon provide independent scientific, maven and creativity services to groundbreaking commercial projects that rely on the acquisition of new technologies or process solutions.
We assist agricultural and industrial entities supersede carbon-intensive activities with renewable, recyclable or regenerative options.
Our clients have commercial aspirations to interact sustainably with land, water, atmosphere, energy and other carbon-intensive industrial products.

Name: LithTech Industries
Description:
LithTech's patented Direct Magnesium Extraction (DME) technology significantly increases the yield and extraction of lithium, nickel, and rare earths by optimising the processing of these minerals by removing magnesium impurities and converting it to a saleable product.

Our mission is to provide a world class solution to industry that ensure a higher yield of valuable resources while drastically reducing environmental waste, tailing dams usage and carbon footprint.

Name: B Circular
Description:
B Circular is an Australian innovation agency enabling traceability, circular supply chains, and next-generation textile solutions for the global apparel industry. We operate at the intersection of technology, textiles, and garment production, supporting brands, governments, and manufacturers to transition toward circular design, regenerative materials, and transparent supply chains.

Our work spans sustainable textile innovation, ethical sourcing and procurement, traceability systems and Digital Product Passports, regenerative material development, and circular product and manufacturing design.

Our ecosystem includes ArcFlexTM, our textile innovation division focused on scalable plant-based and advanced materials engineered for performance and durability; AakosTM, which develops biodegradable performance apparel and circular garment systems; and EcoFabric TraceTM, a traceability platform enabling supply chain visibility from fibre origin to finished product.

Headquartered in Sydney and operating globally, B Circular is building the infrastructure for a traceable, circular fashion economy.

Name: SORET TECH
Description:
For thousands of years, evaporation was the only thermal method known to humankind for refining fluids — not anymore. Soret Tech is revolutionising brine refining and desalination with thermodiffusion-based technologies — no evaporation, no membranes, no chemicals.

Our Vision: To revolutionise brine concentration and desalination processes, making them more cost-effective through innovative thermodiffusion technology.

Our Mission: To replace traditional thermal methods with advanced evaporation-free thermodiffusion technology, providing a more cost-effective and reliable solution to brine concentration or dilution.

Name: Anchor Carbon
Description:
We produce biochar and carbon removal credits while generating renewable energy.

Our innovative technology helps companies decarbonise, optimise under-utilised waste, enrich soil health, and improve the quality of life for regional communities.

Name: Cybrform
Description:
Cybrform is transforming the way motorcycles are designed and built. Founded by a collective of motorcycle enthusiasts and tech innovators, we empower studios, startups, and emerging brands to bring their electric motorcycle ideas to life faster and more efficiently than ever.

Our AI-powered Cybrform Studio and modular electric platforms allow designers to go from 2D concept to 3D prototype in weeks, not years. With a stable, validated engineering foundation, studios can focus on what truly defines a motorcycle: creativity, identity, and vision.

Key platforms include:

C-STA: Modular architecture with integrated battery, defined geometry, and ready-to-use electric drivetrain—perfect for accelerating custom builds.

C-PRO: Reinforced structure and higher output capacity for high-performance applications, designed for demanding real-world conditions.

From café racers to adventure bikes, multiple motorcycle identities can emerge from the same electric platform. Cybrform streamlines the process, reduces development complexity, and enables creators to scale their brands with speed and confidence.

Your brand. Your design. Our technology.

Name: ABR Global
Description:
ABR Global is a world-leading Australian environmental technology company, at the forefront of carbon capture and utilisation. We’re focused on developing and commercialising technologies to decarbonise industry, specifically by turning waste streams into innovative materials. Our Intellectual Property portfolio includes carbon capture and utilisation (CCU), waste recycling, and material innovation.

At ABR, we believe the leading businesses of tomorrow will be those who can integrate environmental and economic outcomes. By working to protect and improve the natural environment, businesses will reap economic rewards – whether by increasing market share, commercialising waste, or capitalising on opportunities to innovate for a brighter tomorrow.

We’re leading by example, and taking others with us on the journey.

Name: AlliVolt
Description:
AlliVolt Technologies Pty Ltd is an Australian battery company focused on building the country’s first locally based Gigafactory for prismatic Li-ion and Na-ion battery cells. We are working to strengthen global energy storage supply chains by delivering safe, long-life, and cost-competitive battery solutions for residential, commercial & industrial (C&I), and utility-scale applications, including fast-growing sectors such as AI data centers.

We are building Australia’s sovereign battery cell manufacturing capability and an advanced, integrated battery ecosystem. By localizing production, we aim to:

- Enhance supply chain resilience,
- Reduce geopolitical risk exposure,
- Diversify global battery cell sourcing.

In parallel, we actively support Australian battery material startups, international early-stage technology companies, and universities through pilot validation, engineering integration, and early-stage commercialization support. Our pilot service model is based in Australia with a fully controlled pilot base (200 t/y materials and 20 MWh/y cylindrical & pouch cells) in China, supported by an experienced cell engineering team. This allows us to: 

- Accelerate technology validation, 
- Reduce commercialization risk,
- Provide faster, more flexible, and cost-effective pathways from materials innovation to cell-level demonstration.

Beyond commercial execution, we are committed to developing high-value green jobs and collaborating with education and industry partners to strengthen local industry capability. We are working to complete Australia’s domestic battery value chain and to position Australia at the forefront of advanced energy storage manufacturing. Through this, we aim to transform Australia from a raw-material supplier into a leader in battery innovation, manufacturing, and system-level integration.

Name: Fire Resilience Technologies
Description:
Fire-Resilient Technologies (FRT) is developing scalable, fire-resilient materials that exceed today’s safety, sustainability, and regulatory standards. Backed by RMIT, FRT is advancing certified, high-performance, non-combustible solutions for rapid adoption across housing, infrastructure, and energy storage markets. Our capital-light, IP-led licensing model enables global reach without the burden of manufacturing.
Fire Resilience Technologies has worked closely with RMIT to develop novel insulating foams from our patented polymers and waste products. This breakthrough will change elements of the construction industry, and we are keen to partner with organizations of substance, to maximize the reach of our products.

Name: Australian Rain Technologies
Description:
Australian Rain Technologies (ART) has broken the traditional paradigm of meteorological statistical analysis. It has applied the most advanced developments in statistical methodology to deal with previous limitations to environmental and climatological research. This has enabled enormously advantageous decision-making around rainfall enhancement technologies.

ART is a commercial company committed to the effective deployment of rainfall enhancement technologies. ART is focused on research and development of ground-based ionisation technologies and on advancing predictive and assessment statistical methodologies.

Wholly owned by Matt and Clare Handbury, ART operates the ATLANT ionisation rainfall enhancement technology, developed by the same scientists at General Electric who developed chemical cloud-seeding after World War II.

Cognizant of the issues cloud-seeding trials have encountered with achieving consistently significant results over 70 years, we have applied ourselves tirelessly to finding and working with spatio-temporal statisticians to overcome the various statistical challenges in dealing with rainfall enhancement trial data.

These efforts have led to consistent results of high statistical confidence over the past 10 years.
